cover.alt: Her project cover: a collage of glossy red lips with gold teeth around a girl in a red cap, glasses and a red satin top, over dark and red-washed denim, with a screaming mouth that reads I AM MY OWN MUSE and glitch blocks along the bottom.

moodboard.alt: Her INSPIRATION board: a collage on pink paper of a white racing helmet, WARREN ST and ONE WAY street signs, a motorbike wheelie at night, a burst of fire, a giant safety pin and a zip, a concrete tower block, a crowd in smoke, a red gem in silver foil, two crumpled Pantone chips and red star shapes, tagged racing, edgy, raw and urban.

collection.alt: Her collection, three illustrated looks in red leather-look and dark denim: a cut-out crop top tied with bows over culottes with red stripes; a glossy red leather jacket with a pleated mini skirt and studded thigh-high boots; a red and denim bustier with a red sash and wide trousers panelled in red.
